frequency_question: What proportion of major transboundary water treaty renewals or successor agreements are successfully negotiated and signed within a two-year preparation window prior to expiration?
membership_rule: Includes formal interstate water sharing treaties requiring joint hydrological data collection, cabinet approval, and legal drafting prior to expiration; excludes unilateral declarations or informal non-binding understandings.
provenance_note: 6 cases named, 8 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.3x)
coverage_note: 6 named cases; estimated 8 total major formal transboundary water treaty renewals meeting strict bilateral criteria globally in this class.
known_gaps: Excludes minor tributary adjustments handled solely at bureaucratic commission levels without ministerial/cabinet signing.
skeleton: Total successful complex bilateral water renewals divided by total scheduled renewals within a 2-year pre-expiration window
multiplier: 6 hits out of 8 attempted major treaty renewals globally in target windows
validity_reason: Bilateral transboundary water treaty frameworks and joint river commission protocols evolve slowly on decadal scales.
